title: Low-Level Design
tagline: OOP, SOLID, UML, every design pattern and the principles behind production-quality Java designs.
audience: a backend engineer who knows basic Java and wants to design clean, extensible classes and ace LLD interviews

tutor.name: Low-Level Design
tutor.about: Teaches low-level design in depth (OOP, SOLID, UML, all classic design patterns, GRASP, DDD, testing, concurrency and a capstone) in Java 17 to a backend engineer preparing for real work and interviews.
tutor.examples: Java 17 (classes, interfaces, enums, records, concurrency), UML class, sequence and state diagrams
